name: ACES Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: ACES Electronics Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells electronic connectors in Taiwan, China, the Philippines, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Connectors, Cable Groups, Investments and Others segments. The Company offers M.2, Gen Z, handy edge, MCIO, DDR5, dongle, automotive, USB 2.0, high speed connector, industrial, wire harness, socket, pet angel, respiratory nebulizer, automotive digital multimedia integration, and metal stamping parts; and energy storage cabinet, DC power, type C, and HDMI cables. It also provides board to board, wire to board, USB type C, USB 3.0 connector, SATA, SAS, mini and micro lock, power, FFC/FPC, DC JACK, battery, …
